title: Machine learning screens fluoroether electrolytes for lithium-metal batteries
summary: The study applies machine learning to a virtual library of 5,576 electrolyte combinations, then synthesizes and tests two candidate fluoroethers. The paper reports nearly 99.5% Coulombic efficiency in specified Li||NMC811 testing. This is a bounded cell result, not evidence that all virtual candidates were made or that either is commercially deployable.
ai_technology: Machine-learning electrolyte property and synthesizability screening

evidence.tested: Primary paper and PubMed abstract support virtual screening, two synthesized candidates and cell testing.
evidence.unknown: Candidate-specific assignment and exact cycling conditions behind near-99.5% metric need supplementary mapping; no commercial cell claim.
evidence.ai_role: ML screens electrolyte property/synthesizability combinations for synthesis and Li-metal cell assessment.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
